components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for starting downloads or confirming modals.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2563EB, #1D4ED8); color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #2563EB; border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 16px; font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3B82F6, #2563EB); border-color: #3B82F6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary control for pausing, resuming, or opening folders.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #172238; color: #F1F5F9; border: 1px solid #273552; border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 16px; font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1E2B45; border-color: #2563EB; color: #60A5FA; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input field for URLs, filenames, and search queries.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Dán liên kết tải tệp tại đây..." />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #131C2E; color: #F1F5F9; border: 1px solid #273552; border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2563EB; background: #172238; }

components.name: Table Card Container
components.description: Main card wrapper enclosing the downloads table grid.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #131C2E; border: 1px solid #1E2B45; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1px; } .ds-card-header { padding: 9px 12px; background: #111827; color: #94A3B8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 1px solid #1E293B; }

components.name: Dynamic Chunk Map Bar
components.css: .ds-chunk-bar { display: flex; height: 18px; background: #162035; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #222F4D; } .ds-chunk-done { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10B981, #059669); } .ds-chunk-active { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2563EB, #06B6D4); } .ds-chunk-pending { background: #162035; }

components.name: Extension Download Button
components.description: 28px circular floating download button for web video players.
components.css: .ds-ext-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); color: #38BDF8; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ext-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.08); color: #60A5FA; border-color: #38BDF8; }

narrative.overview:
The visual world of H2M Download Manager (HDM) is engineered around the metaphor of a high-efficiency precision turbine: fast, silent, perfectly balanced, and purpose-built for sustained high-throughput data transfer. It rejects the bloated, banner-strewn, skeuomorphic legacy of Windows 2000s download managers in favor of a clean, dark-slate instrument aesthetic where every pixel directly serves operational speed and readability.

The atmosphere is composed, technical, and restrained. Surfaces are deep slate tones (#0B0F19 to #131C2E) with subtle ghost borders (#1E2B45). Visual priority belongs exclusively to live data: connection status, real-time segment distribution in the Dynamic Chunk Map, and transfer velocity. Accent highlights use Electric Cobalt Blue (#2563EB) and Speed Cyan (#06B6D4), ensuring users can scan active tasks at a glance without visual fatigue.
keyCharacteristics: Zero Distraction Slate: Dark Slate background with high-contrast text conforming to WCAG AA/AAA.
Tonal Layering over Drop Shadows: Surfaces are flat at rest; spatial hierarchy is achieved through controlled tone stepping.
Micro-Engineered Feedback: Vector icons, dynamic progress bars, and high-visibility segment blocks.
Complete Symmetry across Themes: Both Dark and Light modes share identical layout metrics, typography, and contrast rules.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary Cobalt accent (#2563EB) is strictly reserved for primary actions, active chunk streams, and selected sidebar items. It never covers more than 10% of any viewport.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: All internal surface divisions rely on a crisp 1px border (#1E2B45 in dark mode, #E2E8F0 in light mode) rather than heavy shadows or high-contrast drop dividers.

rules.name: The Numeric Clarity Rule
rules.body: Download speeds (MB/s, KB/s), ETAs, file sizes, and chunk byte ranges are displayed with bold weight and color-coded status, ensuring instant comprehension during active transfers.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are completely flat at rest. Drop shadows appear only as ambient halos on floating menus, browser extension buttons, and modal dialogs.

dos: Do maintain identical layouts and component dimensions when switching between Dark and Light mode.
Do keep the browser extension download button strictly outside the video viewing container on every web surface.
Do format all transfer speeds and data sizes with standardized units (KB/s, MB/s, GB) and bold typography.
Do use the 7px border radius for all actionable buttons, inputs, and selection tabs.
Do use the two-stop gradient (#2563EB to #06B6D4) for active download bars and chunk segments.
donts: Don't use skeuomorphic 3D bevels, glossy glass gradients, or Windows XP-era icon styling.
Don't insert promotional banners, notification ads, or extraneous visual widgets into dialogs.
Don't use heavy drop shadows on static desktop cards or table headers; rely on tonal slate layering.
Don't position the extension download button inside the video player frame where it could obstruct subtitles or media controls.
Don't hardcode hex colors in Python GUI widgets; always query get_palette() from style.py.
